name: Thermal
author: E. T. Carter
description: A thermal camera watching a room of moving heat. Hot sources wander across the frame with convective plumes wavering off them, mapped through a false-colour ramp that climbs from the dark pole to white hot and posterised into isotherm steps with a thin contour at every edge. Detector noise crawls over the image and the lens goes cold toward the corners.

params.label: Isotherm bands
params.effect: Number of temperature steps in the ramp; low is a few broad bands, high approaches a smooth gradient.

params.label: Posterise
params.effect: How hard the ramp steps between bands; 0 is a smooth thermal gradient with no contours, 1 is fully posterised.

params.label: Heat
params.effect: Temperature of the sources; low keeps them in the mid colours, high pushes cores into white-hot bloom.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Speed of the wandering sources, rising plumes and ambient air; 0 freezes the scene (sensor noise still crawls).

params.label: Sensor noise
params.effect: Detector grid noise and fixed row pattern; 0 is a clean render, high is a cheap noisy core.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How much heat the pointer adds to the field; 0 ignores the mouse.
